unique.reason: Simplified text drops hours and the all-traffic caveat; 'a lane just for buses' states the opposite of the proposal. Plainly misinforms respondents.
Proposal framing becomes settled fact ('will'), misrepresenting an open consultation as decided; material loss of meaning.
Hedged modelled estimate becomes an unconditional claim and the car slowdown cost is dropped, skewing the trade-off respondents weigh.
Hidden a11y_profile stores an implied disability with each person's view and exports it by group; discloses disability, and hard-coded label is false.
Real gap: no declared must-keep content and whole page sent to the service, so outputs cannot be checked. Largely a process point.
Week-long cache with no source stamp could serve text from a superseded original; real but conditional on an edit.
Combined signals (IP logs, uid, a11y_profile, blue badge comments) can link disability, view and identity; small groups risk singling out.
Uptake measure counts clicks and a hard-coded label, not comprehension; valid but partly meta commentary with limited direct reader harm.
Unvalidated needs value goes straight into the AI prompt and is cached a week; crafted links could put false text on a council page, and set labels.
Simplified page lacks Easy Read features, drops Read aloud, and puts the full-page link after the form; real barriers for its intended readers.
Simplify control does not say it opens a different AI version with a different form or records a label; unstyled link is a minor inconsistency.
Original text uses jargon and a long sentence, with no map of the lane or moved bays; a modest comprehension burden.
No phone, email, post or assisted route to respond or request formats on either page; web form is the only way to take part.
Single long utterance with no onend/onerror may silently cut off in some browsers; plausible, browser-dependent, not shown in material.
Simple page lacks a heading before the form and any instruction or next-step text; small navigation and comprehension burden.
No validation or check-answers step and switching views loses input; real but mostly general form-usability advice.
